title: 第8章 打斗第9章 干尸
content_zh:
：我随即失声尖叫了一声，身体不知何时已被抓住，整个人站在原地动弹不得。
我刚准备张口喊赵史，可是嘴巴无论如何都发不出任何一点声音！
就在这时，刘倩倩从轿子下面慢慢的踏步走了下来，身穿大红锦袍，头戴凤冠，身披霞帔，脸上画着精致淡淡的妆容。
淡然的一步一步向我走来，芊芊玉指轻轻抚摸着我的脸颊，滑落到我的嘴唇上，悠然的说道：“老公你还是来了！”
刘倩倩说完之后，自顾自的上了轿子，而此时两名纸人扭曲的向我走来，纸人脸上的表情显得尤为扭曲。
两名纸人一人搀扶着我一只手臂，便把我抬上了轿子。
上了轿子之后，我发现刘倩倩就坐在我的正对面，脸上布遮挡着，看不见她脸上任何表情，而我想张嘴说话，却发现还是发不出任何一丝声音。
就这样过了一会儿，花轿外突然传来刺耳的声音。
“吉时已到，开始仪式！”
刘倩倩听了之后，随即一把抓住了我的手，把我从轿子上面带了下去。
下了轿子之后，看着眼前的一幕。
正前方大堂，悬挂着一个大大的哄字！
两边的座位坐着两个纸人，纸人双眼悠悠的瞪着我，仿佛要把我吞噬了一般！
“一拜”
这时旁边传来刚刚刺耳的声音，我寻着声音的来源望去正是一名矮小肥胖的纸人，或者说更像以前的媒婆。
声音刚落下，我的双腿不由自主的跪了下来，身体也开始拜倒。
“二拜~”
这时媒婆尖锐刺耳的声音再次传来。
我的身体不听使唤的转动向后方，再次跪拜了起来。
“小子！

想尽一切办法！
千万不要和刘倩倩跪拜！”
这时候我耳旁突然传来赵史的声音，可是我四下张望一圈之后也没有发现他。
“互相跪拜~”
就在这时，婆子的声音再次传来！
我想到赵史的话，急忙想要控制住自己的身体，停止转动，可是发现无论我怎么用力，身体也不能丝毫，身体正在向刘倩倩的面前转动。
就在即将和刘倩倩跪拜的时候，我想起了舌尖血，我猛的一下咬出舌尖的血！
身体顿时恢复了过来，我急忙停止跪拜撒腿就往外面狂奔而去。
刘倩倩显然没有反应过来，我竟然能摆脱身体控制，看见我撒腿向外跑去，愤怒的扯下脸上的红布，一张精致无比的脸，因为生气显得扭曲了起来！
刘倩倩立马朝我追了过来，而周围的纸人也蜂拥而上地向我靠了过来！
我刚踏出大堂，便感受到凉风刺骨，寒气直逼我的身体，可也顾不上这么多，只能狂奔向前跑去！
刘倩倩飞速向我追来，就在即将快要抓住我的时候，我胸前的玉佩又再次闪耀了起来！
我隐约之中好像听见刘倩倩大叫了一声，不过我并不敢回头，只能继续往前狂奔。
我只记得我一直疯狂奔跑，不知跑了多久，嘴里咳出一口鲜血，呼吸已经完全凌乱，整个人已经完全瘫坐在地，一动不动的躺在那。
我看着胸前的玉佩，好像又是被它救了一命，不过当务之急是要尽快找到赵史，不然的话被刘倩倩追上是早晚。
“小子，没想到你竟然能跑出来。”
content_en:
: I screamed uncontrollably. My body was caught at some point, and I stood there unable to move.
I was about to open my mouth to call Zhao Shi, but no sound came out of my mouth!
At this moment, Liu Qianqian slowly stepped down from the sedan chair, wearing a bright red brocade robe, a phoenix crown on her head, a Xia pei, and delicate and light makeup on her face.
He walked towards me step by step calmly, his delicate jade fingers gently caressed my cheek, slid down to my lips, and said leisurely: "Honey, you are still here!"
After Liu Qianqian finished speaking, she got on the sedan alone. At this time, two paper figures came towards me in a twisted manner, and the expressions on the faces of the paper figures looked particularly twisted.
Two paper figures each supported one of my arms and lifted me onto the sedan.
After getting on the sedan, I found Liu Qianqian sitting directly opposite me, with her face covered by a cloth, so I couldn't see any expression on her face. I wanted to open my mouth to speak, but I still couldn't make any sound.
After a while, a harsh sound suddenly came from outside the sedan.
"The auspicious time has arrived, let's begin the ceremony!"
After Liu Qianqian heard this, she immediately grabbed my hand and took me off the sedan.
After getting off the sedan, he looked at the scene in front of him.
In the lobby directly in front, a big word "coax" is hung!
There were two paper figures sitting on the seats on both sides. The paper figures stared at me leisurely, as if they were going to devour me!
"A bow"
At this time, a harsh sound came from the side. I looked for the source of the sound and saw that it was a short and fat paper man, or more like a matchmaker from before.
As soon as the voice fell, my legs involuntarily knelt down and my body began to prostrate.
"Two thanks~"
At this time, the sharp and harsh voice of the matchmaker came again.
My body turned back uncontrollably and I knelt down again.
"Boy!
Leave no stone unturned!
Never kneel down to Liu Qianqian! "
At this time, Zhao Shi's voice suddenly came to my ears, but I looked around and couldn't find him.
"Kneel down and worship each other~"
At this moment, the mother-in-law’s voice came again!
I thought of Zhao Shi's words and hurriedly tried to control my body and stop turning, but I found that no matter how hard I tried, my body could not move at all, and my body was turning in front of Liu Qianqian.
Just when I was about to kneel down with Liu Qianqian, I remembered the blood on the tip of my tongue, and I bit out the blood on the tip of my tongue!
My body recovered immediately, and I hurriedly stopped kneeling and ran outside.
Liu Qianqian obviously didn't react. I was able to get rid of her body control. When she saw me running away, she angrily pulled off the red cloth on my face. Her delicate face looked distorted because of anger!
Liu Qianqian immediately chased me, and the surrounding paper figures also swarmed towards me!
As soon as I stepped out of the lobby, I felt the biting cold wind, and the cold air hit my body, but I couldn't care less, so I could only run forward!
Liu Qianqian chased me quickly, and just when she was about to catch me, the jade pendant on my chest shone again!
I vaguely seemed to hear Liu Qianqian yelling, but I didn't dare to look back and could only keep running forward.
I only remember that I had been running like crazy for an unknown amount of time. I coughed out a mouthful of blood, my breathing was completely messed up, and I was completely paralyzed on the ground, lying there motionless.
I looked at the jade pendant on my chest, as if it had saved my life again, but the top priority was to find Zhao Shi as soon as possible, otherwise Liu Qianqian would catch up sooner or later.
"Boy, I didn't expect you to run out."
